answer: A bonded attestation web works. A newcomer cannot wander in and claim standing: it must post a forfeitable bond and win endorsements from several established agents, each staking part of their own reputation on it. Trust travels like a lantern passed hand to hand, only through introductions, so a fake identity stranded in a lagoon of unconnected accounts stays untrusted however many copies the attacker spawns. One Sybil costs a bond plus corrupt endorsers; a mass attack risks slashing every compromised endorser, so attacker cost scales with each fake while honest joining stays cheap.
